result.summary: A residential street environment featuring row housing and a marked zebra crosswalk. Pedestrian infrastructure includes sidewalks and curb ramps, but safety is compromised by parked cars obstructing sightlines and a lack of visible traffic control devices.

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked immediately adjacent to the crosswalk obscure pedestrians from the view of oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Curbsides at the intersection corners in the foreground.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Intersection
hazards.description: The absence of stop signs or signals at the marked crossing may lead to higher vehicle speeds and failure to yield.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Removing parking spaces near the intersection to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extending the sidewalk at the corners to reduce crossing distance and prevent illegal parking near the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevating the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to act as a speed table and increase pedestrian prominence.

result.summary: The environment features a mixed-use street with continuous sidewalks and a faded zebra crosswalk. Pedestrian safety is compromised by a delivery vehicle blocking sightlines and the lack of visible traffic control signage at the intersection.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, making the crossing less visible to drivers.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicle
hazards.description: A delivery van is parked close to the intersection, blocking the sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Install speed humps or raised crosswalks to reduce vehicle speeds in this mixed-use area.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk but no visible traffic control signals or stop signs. Parked vehicles along the curb obstruct sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers, and there are no visible curb ramps for accessibility.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk block the view of pedestrians for oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the street approaching the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or signals are visible to regulate traffic at this marked crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: At the intersection of the two streets.

hazards.name: Missing Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The sidewalk ends in a vertical curb without a sloped transition, creating a barrier for people with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corners of the intersection where the sidewalk meets the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to act as a speed table and increase pedestrian prominence.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide, unmarked roadway with faded crosswalk markings and narrow sidewalks. The lack of active traffic control and degraded pavement quality creates a moderately high-risk environment for pedestrians.
